description: Questions for the evaluation of the policy graph (evaluation/graph_eval.py), about policy v2.5 with v2.6 stored beside it. Written by the authors. The dev questions were used while the graph's recognition of questions was built; the test questions were written afterwards and were never used to change it. 'evidence' lists the passages a complete answer rests on, as [rule or section, version]: a rule number names the passage of that rule, a section number (5.1) the section's text, where the table of approval limits is. 'answer' is what the graph must derive, checked against the values of its facts; single-step questions have none.
